# Slingshot

> Slingshot is a free, open-source desktop application that opens a project's full development environment — editor, terminals, browser tabs, and dev servers — with a single click. Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Licensed under AGPL v3.

Built with Tauri 2 (Rust), Vue 3, and SQLite. Designed for developers who repeat the same setup ritual for every project they work on.

- Author: Atia Farha
- Source: https://github.com/Atia-Farha/Slingshot
- License: AGPL-3.0 (https://sling-shot.pages.dev/license)
- Pricing: Free, no paid tiers
